name: Tsuzuki Satoshi
source:
An university student and a quarter Russian (his grandmother was Russian).  
Surrounded by nature ever since he was born, he has found interest in plants and has aimed to become a botanist. As a result, he has chosen to go to an university famous for its botanic studies. 
Currently his main focus is studying mountain plants, he was supposed to continue his studies on them but he was a little bothered about his home village and home.

Satoshi has extremely good grades, and even in the university he's among the top students. He's very active in the wild, often going out into the mountains, as a result he is more muscular and durable than his looks suggest.
